## recipe-173 — Refined Verdant Tackle

**REVIEWED — authored operational PLAYTEST.** public; Fishing level 4; tier 2; Common; crafting DC 12; Standard quantity 4.

**Preserved source effect:** Grants +1 to Fishing checks. On a successful catch, gain 1 additional unit of usable meat or material; tagged bait preferentially attracts flora-aligned creatures.

**Operational effect:** On one eligible ordinary provision catch check, this actual participating Tackle offers +1 in equipment.leather-task-enhancement; choose the strongest independently eligible modifier once. It offers 1 in equipment.fishing-extra-recovery, separately compared at secure capture among sources that qualified at the check and still qualify. The first secure capture records one recovery evaluation for that physical creature, including zero; later recapture cannot raise it. Authorize only available disjoint real reserve units for later lawful harvesting, never immediate meat or extra creatures. Its one selectable attraction affinity is Flora; choose one source before one finite, weighted response allocation within 30 feet of connected water path. Local availability, perception, response and physical fit remain required. The three choices are independent; tags never combine automatically. The complete item must have positive structural HP, remain unsuppressed and unmelded, and actually participate in the registered method. It is reusable, but supplies no bait/chum or new opportunity. Neither case grants a separate activation, RP, concentration, charges, proficiency, AC candidate, resistance, food credit or bonus on harvesting, repair, research, creation or combat.

| 6 x 4 x 2-inch control board, winder, float, sinker and clips; no rod, line or hook | 1 | 1 | 5 / 15 | Rod |

**Assembly and use:** Mount the control board to the Rod or stable support so it actually controls the admitted line. Supply separate Rod, Line, Hook and bait/Lure. This output is not the 1 gp / 4 lb tool kit or a boat. All methods require actual prey/opportunity, access, receiving arrangements and the shared guide; maximum one unresolved deployment per lead.

**Attempt:** Five setup minutes, fifty fishing minutes, one WIS/Fishing check at minute 55, then five active retrieval minutes. Each active six seconds uses an Action and the actual required hands. DC 12 / 15 / 18 is assigned to feasible site conditions before commitment, independently of this crafting DC. Untrained catching has disadvantage and no PB. One trained Rod/Net assistant earns +1 only after all 55 prior work minutes; Trap uses setter WIS/PB snapshot and current gear at its one due check, with no assistant. Rod/Net secure control must occur before closure ten elapsed minutes after the check. Real stock and one response allocation are required; failure spends the opportunity.

**Reserve:** 6 actual ordered complete Standard mundane bodies, never previously magically altered. Reserve exclusively before work. Latest lawful age, condition and damage apply; missing/ineligible bodies pause before rolling. Transform first resolved N with no post-roll reordering or purchases; unused reserves remain actual ordinary stock. Source process materials are additional, not body mass.

**Source component occurrences:**

| # | Component | Quantity | Tier | Role | Consumed | Unit lb | Unit gp | Properties |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | Weighted sinker | 4 | 2 | bait | True | 0.05 | 8 | bait |
| 1 | living root | 1 | 1 | material | True | 0.29 | 12 | botanical, organic, regenerative, vital |

All listed occurrences are mandatory consumed process inputs once per batch. **No catalyst return.** Failed non-catalyst recovery is exactly the framework's 25% with actual divisibility and original ages; Mishap/abandonment return none. Role bait is not a finished Bait dose or an attempt's bait supply. Ordinary tools and reserved bodies are separate.

**Work and access:** Source 8 hours; 8 actual active hours, including the first 15-minute stable incorporation phase; divide remaining 7.75 hours into declared phases of at most eight hours. WIS and the actual non-artisan Fishing-tackle credential, toolkit, Knife, Bait container and Shoreline, dock, or fishing station are required. Source requiredTools: Fishing tackle, Knife, Bait container. fieldCraftable=true, timeMode=expedition; both govern actual station access. Ordinary tools/facilities grant +0. No Forge Dwarf time or quality benefit. Maximum assistants 0, each working all actual hours; no time reduction. Untrained level 1–4 and higher formula gates follow the framework. Trade level is not added to the roll.

**Discovery:** {"sources": ["trainer", "starter manual", "common experimentation"], "minimumResearchHours": 0, "requiresFormula": false, "formulaConsumed": false}. Preserve trivialAtSkillLevel=9 and source progression; do not regenerate level + 5. Actual incorporation stabilizes only eligible incorporated inputs, never already spoiled or untouched material. Interruption loses unfinished phase progress without refunding actual consumed inputs.

**Quality:** Standard 4; Exceptional yield 5; Masterwork yield 6; Flawed 2. Alternatively retain Q bodies with strongest 25% / 50% structural improvement. Ordinary HP 5 becomes 6 / 7; one persistent flaw halves last to 2 / 3 / 3. Preserve damage deficit, so a positive-HP reserve can emerge Broken. Flawed keeps existing flaws but adds none, even when the resolved yield is one. Failed/Mishap gives zero outputs. Bonuses, extra recovery, affinity, capacity, reach, grade and permission never improve.

**Repair:** Trained WIS + one Fishing PB/expertise, actual toolkit, Knife, Bait container and station. Functional DC 10, max(1 hour, recorded maximum HP / 10), material reference 0.25 gp. Broken DC 12, max(8 hours, recorded maximum HP / 10), material reference 79/16 gp. Require original control board and winder and all prerecorded additional irreplaceable constituents. Small subordinate fittings/patches may be replaced; missing primary assemblies cannot. Success restores recorded maximum HP; failure spends work/materials. No formula/creation-level gate, quality, XP, flaw removal, Forge Dwarf reduction or history/refill reset.

**Finished undamaged unit reference:** 19.75 gp = source Standard batch value / Q + 1 gp body. Keep exact fractions until a real purchase (round up to copper) or sale (round down). No quality-yield divisor, double ingredient charge, guaranteed buyer or automatic artifact/rarity multiplier. Owned stock needs no repurchase; depleted/damaged/flawed sale price needs an actual quote.

**Capture and material boundary:** Check success is not death or harvested inventory. Record one physical creature and its first extra-recovery evaluation, including zero, with only actual disjoint reserve units. Release, recapture and transfer retain this history. Actual later lawful harvest uses existing source DC/time/tools, category-order/partial-forfeiture rules and death/removal ages. These catch bonuses do not aid extraction. No automatic ration, neutralized food, named ingredient or complete Supply Unit is produced. A shared physical pool cannot also yield overlapping Forage stock in the same Watch.

## recipe-92 — Refined Storm Roast

**Source:** public; Cooking level 3; tier 2; Common; DC 11; 1 active hours; 5 serving(s). Standard batch reference 69 gp.

**Preserved effect:** After a 10-minute meal, gain 4 temporary hit points and resistance to lightning damage for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from one feast at a time.

**Operational effect:** After completing and accepting this feast, offer 4 temporary HP. Gain resistance to lightning damage for 1 elapsed hour(s), ending earlier with the parent feast.

**Duration:** Parent feast and its temporary HP end at the next completed beneficial Long Rest. Every rider also ends when this feast ends or is replaced. Its explicitly shorter deadline remains separate.

**Work:** Cookfire or Kitchen; Cook's utensils, Knife, Pot or pan. Mode field; field flag true; maximum assistants 0; formula required false.

**Exact ingredients:** 2 × Butter (component tier 2; 0.1 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; seasoning; consumed); 1 × Water (component tier 2; 0.5 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; solvent; consumed); 2 × Vegetables (component tier 2; 0.1 lb/unit; 8 gp/unit; substrate; consumed); 1 × sparkling petal (component tier 1; 0.36 lb/unit; 10 gp/unit; material; consumed).

**Food reservation:** 0.4 lb credited nutritive source inputs; up to 0 lb may return as the selected catalyst. For Standard quantity without catalyst retention, add 2.94 lb real ration-equivalent food. Before any completion check reserve 4.27 lb supplementary food for full Masterwork yield and worst legal nutritive catalyst retention. This is additional to every exact ingredient. Reservation does not consume food; after the outcome/catalyst choice and before finished servings are created, incorporate only the actual required amount. Generic failure without a finished product leaves all supplement unincorporated; a specific failed product spends only its required supplement. Actual food reference is 25 cp/lb, prorated from 5 sp per 2-lb daily ration; supplier quotes and transaction rounding still apply.

**Serving and storage:** each serving contains exactly 2/3 lb food and credits 1/3 Small/Medium daily food or 1/6 Large daily food after complete consumption. Before rolling, predeclare actual output dispositions for all 7 possible servings: real compatible storage capacity or distinct present recipients ready to begin immediate ten-minute consumption, one simultaneous slot per recipient. Immediate servings commit at batch completion; an invalid immediate slot needs actual reserved storage or cannot use the exception. Existing containers count only to their real capacity. A dedicated Meal Crock is 0.5 lb empty, 2 sp, 1 quart, AC 13/HP 2; one serving gives 7/6 lb gross. No water, fuel or full Supply is supplied by this food credit. Finished-food shelf life is 24 unprotected elapsed hours.

**Flawed:** {"mode": "half-batch-quantity", "quantity": 2}. Quality can change finite yield or dedicated mundane packaging durability; it does not improve meal potency. A dedicated Meal Crock first improved from maximum HP 2 to 3 gains exactly +1 current HP, preserving existing damage; an already-HP-3 crock gains neither again.

**Nutritional source map:** Butter counts as ordinary food; Water has no credited nutritive bulk in this card; Vegetables counts as ordinary food; sparkling petal has no credited nutritive bulk in this card.
